		German-RAG - German Retrieval Augmented Generation
	


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

This German-RAG-EMBEDDING-BENCHMARK represents a specialized collection for evaluating embedding models.
You can use this dataset with this Evaluation Notebook in Colab:
https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1KlIRchSlCtKg9C_bZkdWaYLxROeB0Fr_?usp=sharing
Additonally we have evaluated our Models on German Subsets of the MTEB Benchmark with this Evaluation Notebook… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/avemio/German-RAG-EMBEDDING-BENCHMARK.
reputation: Niche, used by practitioners working on German retrieval/embedding evaluation and as a German-focused complement to MTEB.
